children: Private sector IDFC FIRST Bank on Friday said it has removed forex markup charges for all existing and new credit card customers, with no conditions attached.
The benefit is automatically available to all cardholders, giving customers confidence to use the bank's credit cards for their global spending, IDFC FIRST Bank said in a statement.
Customers do not need to apply for a new card, upgrade their existing card, or meet any spending threshold to avail this benefit, it said.
Their current IDFC FIRST Bank credit card now comes with zero forex markup, with no conditions attached, it added.

title: IDFC FIRST Bank removes forex markup across all credit cards
